title: Doubling Loop Register Update
statement: For any language $P$, input word $x$, and natural number $n$ with $2^n\le B$, whenever $a+k=n$, the search program with oracle determined by $P$ can reach location $\mathrm{enum}$ with registers $(0,2^n,0,0)$ from location $\mathrm{dbl}$ with registers $(k,2^a,0,0)$. Throughout the run before reaching that configuration, the program precondition holds and every register is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: The input is $x$ and the oracle is determined by $P$
